summary: The top Fortinet FortiRecon EASM, BP, and ACI package: external attack surface, brand protection, dark web, threat intelligence and supplier assessment.
value: A full picture of external risk: assets, brand, leaks and suppliers.
Leaks and talk of attacks on the company on the dark web and stealer markets are spotted in time.
It shows which suppliers an attacker could use to reach the company.
simple: Fortinet’s attack surface management service (CTEM). Searches the internet for everything that belongs to the company — domains, servers, cloud resources — and shows prioritized vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, leaked credentials, risks of subsidiaries and companies being acquired, and runs a surface-level check of web applications. The internal module (IASM) scans internal subnets through a Docker agent, finding devices and their vulnerabilities. Executive reports, API, integration with FortiGate and AWS, GCP and Azure, and playbooks for responding to findings (100 runs per month). Brand protection: watches for lookalike domains, phishing sites (including via digital watermarking), logo impersonation, leaks in code repositories and cloud storage, rogue mobile apps and fake social media accounts, and executives’ data (10 people); two takedowns of fraudulent resources over the account lifetime, real-time alerts and analyst support. Adversary-centric intelligence (ACI) from FortiGuard Labs: the darknet, open sources, technical data and threat actor profiles, stolen-data marketplaces (stealer-infected computers, cards), continuous asset scanning, vulnerability and ransomware intelligence across the supply chain, risk assessments for 25 vendors, and reputation lookups for IPs, domains, hashes and CVEs.
notIncluded: Red Teaming is a separate service.
classification: ACI: dark web and stealer markets map to dark web monitoring, technical intelligence and IoCs to threat intelligence, Vendor Risk Assessment (25) to TPRM.
